title: N=4 SYM to two loops: compact expressions for the non-compact symmetry algebra of the su(1,1|2) sector
claim: Two-loop dilatation generator of the non-compact su(1,1|2) sector written as nested commutators of four O(g) generators and one auxiliary generator, after deriving the complete O(g^3) symmetry algebra of the sector; conjectured valid for any gauge group; checked against published field-theory results; used for anomalous dimensions and the sl(2) internal S-matrix.
scheme: algebraic (deformed symmetry algebra), with field-theory checks
symmetry_argument: order-by-order closure of the perturbatively corrected superconformal algebra on operators

proved: within the algebraic framework: compact form of the two-loop generator
assumed: existence of corrected generators satisfying the algebra to O(g^3)
checked_partially: agreement with direct field-theory calculations (per abstract)
